purpose: 界面评审，非已实现功能；仅使用虚构数据
design: 浅色桌面应用，任务优先，八个页面
shared_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one high-fidelity, production-quality Chinese Windows desktop application interface screenshot, landscape 16:10, high resolution with very crisp legible Simplified Chinese text. This is an actual full application screen design, NOT a poster, NOT a collage, NOT a phone mockup, no surrounding computer hardware, no perspective. Product name exactly “求职助手”. A fresh, highly usable desktop productivity app for job applicants, task oriented, NOT a developer dashboard. Professional restrained visual design: light warm-gray workspace #F6F7F9, WHITE left sidebar, fine #E5E7EB borders, deep charcoal text, saturated cobalt-blue #2563EB main actions, soft blue active nav, amber for needs-attention, green for confirmed status. No dark teal sidebar. Clear typography reminiscent of Microsoft YaHei/Inter, large 28px page titles, clear 14-16px body text, generous but economical spacing, 8px rounded corners, subtle shadows, consistent simple outline icons. Windows-style thin title bar at top with app name and minimize/maximize/close at far right. Fixed 200px left sidebar with exact nav labels in this order: “首页”, “我的资料”, “公司网申”, “BOSS 投递”, “自动回复”, “执行工作台”, “消息中心”, “投递记录”; bottom “设置与帮助”. Small avatar bottom labeled “我的账户”. Header location and page title on right, page-specific main action top right. All visible copy must be coherent readable Simplified Chinese, avoid lorem ipsum and overlong dense text. Use normal application layout, not marketing landing page, not KPI-card dashboard. Keep all eight screen designs using this exact same shell, typography, palette, nav order. No programming terms, JSON, run_id, CLI, API keys, file paths or console exposed to ordinary user. Fictional names and companies only. Small discreet bottom-right text “界面方案 · 示例数据”. Visually obvious primary and secondary actions. All content fully inside the image, no clipped text.

pages.title: 首页：开始任务与处理待办
pages.spec: Active nav “首页”. Header title “今天，开始新的机会”, smaller subtitle “资料已准备好，选择一种方式开始投递。” Top-right subdued “查看投递记录”. Main upper content a readiness strip with green checks “简历已就绪”“个人资料已确认”“浏览器待连接” (last neutral). Main centerpiece THREE large clear ACTION panels horizontal, equal widths, each with an outline icon, a concise purpose, and strong blue button: “公司官网网申” / “按公司清单填写申请，逐页留档” / “导入公司表”; “BOSS 快速沟通” / “使用平台筛选结果，按顺序沟通” / “设置筛选条件”; “BOSS AI 精筛” / “阅读职位要求，优先投递匹配岗位” / “设置求职偏好”. Under these two-column section: left 60% “继续未完成的任务”, one task row “嵌入式工程师 · 公司网申”, “已完成 3 / 12 家”, subtle progress bar 25%, amber tag “已暂停”, button “继续任务”, small last company “当前：远山科技”; second row BOSS pending configuration. right 40% prominent attention queue “需要你处理 · 3”, first amber-bordered row “明川智能 · 面试邀约” “请确认周五下午的面试时间” button “去处理”; second “资料待补充 · 1 项” button “补充资料”. Footer modest inline today totals “今日已投递 8  ·  收到回复 3  ·  待处理 3”, no oversized decorative metrics. Make entry paths and resume/attention unmistakable.

Content left narrow column 32% a file card “当前简历”, PDF icon and “张晨_嵌入式工程师.pdf”, green “已解析”, buttons “预览简历”“更换文件”; beneath a drag-and-drop zone “拖入个人信息文件” “支持 Word、PDF、Excel”, button “选择文件”; below a progress card “资料完整度 92%” small progress bar and amber “1 项需要核对”. Content right editable clean form card “基本资料”, small tag “内容来自已导入文件”: 姓名 张晨, 手机号 138 **** 2468, 邮箱 zhangchen@example.com, 所在城市 深圳, 求职状态 在职，考虑机会, 到岗时间 确认录用后两周. Email fictional example.com. Each field is a well-spaced native-looking input, two columns. Lower “求职意向” fields 目标岗位 嵌入式软件工程师, 意向城市 深圳、广州 as removable chips, 薪资期望 15–20K · 税前月薪. An amber highlighted field “毕业时间” shows “2023 年 6 月” with small “请与原文件核对”, clickable “查看来源”. Footer reassuring “仅使用你确认过的信息，不自动编造缺失内容。” A fixed unobtrusive bottom action row “还有 1 项待核对” and “保存草稿” secondary, “确认资料” blue. No code, no manual path input.

Subtle note “缺少信息时暂停该申请并提醒我”. Bottom toolbar selection “已选择 3 家公司” secondary “保存任务” primary large “复核并开始网申”. Source table unchanged badge “原表格保留不变”. Show selection and next action clearly.

pages.title: BOSS投递：两种模式与筛选条件
pages.spec: Active nav “BOSS 投递”. Header “创建 BOSS 投递任务”, subtitle “选择筛选方式，确认投递范围与沟通数量。” Main top two large segmented selectable MODE cards: left “按推荐列表沟通”, description “在 BOSS 设置筛选条件后，按推荐顺序沟通，不逐一阅读详情”; right “AI 阅读岗位精筛”, description “阅读岗位内容，按你的条件判断后再沟通”, right SELECTED blue outline and radio. Content main left 65% form grouped by meaning: “基本条件” fields 目标岗位 chips “嵌入式工程师”“固件工程师”, 工作城市 深圳 / 广州 chips, 薪资范围 15–20K dropdown, 工作经验 1–3年 dropdown. “精筛偏好” checked “排除外包”“只看全职”“优先直接招聘”; labeled technical chips STM32 / C / RTOS; text field “其他要求” value “优先有实际产品研发的团队”. Right 35% task summary sticky card “本轮执行规则”: “最多沟通 20 个岗位” numeric stepper, “首次沟通：使用 BOSS 已设置的话术”, “简历附件：对方索要后发送”, “陌生问题：提醒我处理” select, amber tiny “面试邀约始终交给你确认”. Bottom primary wide “复核并开始投递”, secondary “保存为常用配置”. Thin footer “到达上限后可继续检查新回复”. Do not suggest an endless unbounded spam task. Clearly distinguish mode choice and screening fields.

pages.title: 自动回复：可视化规则与匹配预览
pages.spec: Active nav “自动回复”. Header “自动回复规则”, subtitle “常见问题使用你的原话回复，条件不清楚时交给你。” Top-right blue “新增回复规则”. Tabs “常见问题” active and “其他问题处理”. Three-column functional layout: left 23% rule list cards “薪资是否接受” enabled active, “工作地点” enabled, “多久可以到岗” enabled; bottom disabled gray “出差与加班” switch off. Center 47% editor title “薪资是否接受”, switch “启用此规则”. Section “满足以下条件时”, two clean form rows “薪资口径” dropdown “税前月薪”, “金额不低于” numeric “15,000” unit 元; AND chip between rows. Section “使用我的回复原文” large textarea “这个薪资范围可以接受，谢谢。” small “匹配后直接使用原文，不改写”. Footer secondary “取消修改” primary “保存规则”. Right 30% test panel pale blue border “试一条消息”, message sample “税前月薪 16K，可以接受吗？”, button “测试匹配”, green “匹配成功”, reply preview bubble with EXACT same reply. Below amber mini example “薪资 16K，周五来面试可以吗？” then “包含面试邀约 → 整条消息转人工”. Bottom full-width muted rule bar “没有匹配规则的问题” radio selected “提醒我回答”, alternate “让 AI 根据我的资料组织回复”. Dense enough useful but clear hierarchy, not JSON editor.

pages.title: 执行工作台：进度、画面与接管
pages.spec: Active nav “执行工作台”. Header “正在执行 · 公司官网网申”, subheading “嵌入式工程师 · 本轮 12 家公司”. Most prominent persistent top control strip shows blue outlined “暂停并接管”, neutral “仅值守”, red outlined “停止本轮”, left green “任务执行中” and small “AI 会话已连接” AS MOCKUP state. Three-pane workspace: narrow left 24% “申请队列”, top progress “已完成 3 / 12”, compact rows fictional companies with clear status: 望岳系统 已完成 green, 北辰微电 已完成 green, 清禾机器人 已完成 green, 远山科技 填写中 blue SELECTED, 明川智能 等待中 gray, 星屿电子 等待中 gray. Center 51% “当前：远山科技 / 嵌入式软件工程师”, horizontally numbered workflow “打开岗位 ✓ → 填写资料 ● → 上传简历 → 提交核验”. Large embedded screenshot preview with generic fictional company career form (姓名 张晨, 邮箱 zhangchen@example.com, 项目经历, 上传附件), explicitly top label “浏览器最近截图” and footer “更新于 14:32:08 · 非实时视频”, small button “放大查看”. At bottom amber but restrained warning strip “需要使用电脑？先暂停，完成后再继续。” No misleading continuous video player or developer logs. Controls easy to find from any point.

Left 24% conversation list with tabs “待我处理 3”“全部消息”; selected row fictional “明川智能 · 陈女士”, amber label “面试邀约”, snippet “周五下午三点方便面试吗？”; another row 远山科技 · 李先生 / “问题待确认”; another 清禾机器人 / “新回复”.
